title: Ring, luck and chatter
summary: Interviewers chat with Punch about his good-luck ring, a visiting group, and the bulls song.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: No, I ain't talking about them three guys. Three guys? Yeah. They must be at three o'clock. But I mean, they'll be all right.
Yeah, well, don't worry about it.
We'll leave when they come. Your ring, did someone give this to you for good luck?
No, I bought that ring. You know why you bought it? Hmm?
Tell them why you bought it, Ponce.
I bought it for good luck. I bought it at a... Well, don't drop it.
What do you name? Oh. Johnny Reef or something on it. What do you name?
On Rampaw at the Hawk Show?
No. No, I know our boy. That's Jack Rose.

Oh, yeah. I know. About stuff. Hmm. What were we talking about, the bulls? Oh, didn't he ramble, huh? You know the words that the bulls used to say? Bulls? Yeah, didn't they have words to that? Zutty told me about that one. Oh, you pleaded?
You played for me. Did you play with Denny Ramble?
